name: Tombs of the Sand Kings
title: Tombs of the Sand Kings
summary: Three small stone tomb bunkers (7.8 m, 4 m tall) in a row on a narrow sandstone ridge (z 56) 300 m east of Candeth Keep (87.7S 65.6W); the westernmost is Anadil's Tomb, and Garaena the Emissary waits here. The Direlands Midland drop, a Life Stone and the destroyed portal to Hebian-To are 300 m to the south-east.
